card.text: A Cepheid in the Milky Way, 50 times the Sun's width, that swells and shrinks every 7.6 days.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
sources.locator: table10, RS Ori: Per, Rad, Dist

introduction.text: Its mean radius, 50.5 solar radii, comes from comparing how fast its surface moves with how its size changes, 1,586 parsecs away.

sources.label: Groenewegen (2012)
